notes.title: Soundtrack release & Localization
notes.notes:
[b]SOUNDTRACK[/b]
For some reason I never announced the Apple Slash OST release here on Steam, my bad LOL

It certainly exists, and you most certainly can find here in it's entirety:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355080/Apple_Slash_Soundtrack/

It also comes with 3+ unused tracks that didn't make for the game's release!


[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]
The game is now available in 6+ languages, which are the following:
-Japanese
-Russian
-German
-French
-Spanish
-Norwegian

If you want to help out by adding more languages to the game, by all means feel free to contact me: agelvik.contact@gmail.com

[b]Bugs/Polish/Fixes[/b]
Been doing a lot of minor tweaks nobody really cares about, but hey... how about these new cool attack animations I've been implementing?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983350/2d67d53238afe11d1bab199c0183f1304f2a7f8f.gif[/img]

Eh? ... EH?!


Anyways, that's it for now. Have fun and have some good soundtrack listening. Until next time, cheers!
/André
